$comment: Test corpus for measure.mjs. Deliberately generic — the point is that the SAME prompts go to every ecosystem, and each guide should improve them differently. `has` lists what the prompt ALREADY supplies; recommending one of those back is the failure the harness counts. `has` is a judgement call, so keep entries unambiguous: tag only what a reader would agree is plainly present. `modality` filters video-only concepts (audio, shot duration) out of image runs.

dimensions.subject: concrete, specific subject description beyond a bare noun
dimensions.lighting: named light source, direction, quality, or time-of-day-as-lighting
dimensions.camera: shot type, angle, lens, framing, or camera movement
dimensions.composition: where elements sit in frame, depth, foreground/background
dimensions.style: named rendering style, medium, or artistic reference
dimensions.audio: sound design: ambient bed, named events (video only)

A cartographer in a wool waistcoat leans over a half-finished map on a broad oak table, dividers in one hand, ink-stained fingers steadying the vellum. A single brass desk lamp throws warm light from camera right, leaving the shelves behind him in deep shadow. Shot as a slightly high three-quarter view, the map filling the lower half of the frame and the man's face in the upper left. Painterly, muted earth tones, fine detail on the paper texture.

An abandoned municipal swimming pool reclaimed by birch saplings pushing up through cracked tiles, drained deep end filled with drifted leaves, faded lane markings still visible on the walls. Flat overcast daylight with no hard shadows, the whole scene desaturated toward grey-green. Composition centred on the diving board, which juts from the left edge into empty air. Photographic realism, fine grain.
A locked frame never moves as a barista steams milk behind a counter. Audio: low espresso machine hiss, a spoon tapping ceramic twice, quiet cafe murmur.

Two knights duel on a frozen lake. Audio: blades clashing, boots cracking ice, distant crow calls over a low wind bed.

A signalman walks the length of a rain-slicked railway platform at night, lantern swinging at his side, coat collar turned up. The camera tracks him laterally from across the tracks, holding a steady medium-wide. Sodium platform lamps throw pooled orange light with long gaps of darkness between. Audio: rain on the canopy, boots on wet concrete, a distant coupling clank.
